pattern.deadline_window: Paper deadline on a Thursday in late May to early June when the conference is in November (Jun 8 2023, Jun 6 2024, May 28 2026); shifted to Apr 30 in 2025 when the conference moved to late September. Abstract registration ~3 days (2026) to 7 days (2025) before the paper deadline, introduced in 2025. All deadlines 23:59 AoE (UTC-12). Supplementary materials one week after the paper deadline (2024-2026).
pattern.typical_notification: Early September for November conferences (Aug 30 2023, Sep 4 2024, Sep 4 2026); Aug 1 in 2025. Roughly 13-14 weeks after the paper deadline.
pattern.typical_reviews_released: Early August (Aug 3 2023, Aug 2 2024, Aug 4 2026; Jun 25 2025), i.e. ~8-10 weeks after the deadline; rebuttal window 7 days in 2025-2026 (11-12 days in 2023-2024).
pattern.typical_conference_month: November, Mon-Thu, 4 days (Nov 6-9 2023, Nov 6-9 2024, Nov 9-12 2026); exception: Sep 27-30 2025 (co-located with Humanoids 2025).
pattern.location_rotation: Alternates between the US and other regions: 2017 Mountain View (US), 2018 Zurich (CH), 2019 Osaka (JP), 2020 virtual/MIT (US), 2021 London (UK), 2022 Auckland (NZ), 2023 Atlanta (US), 2024 Munich (DE), 2025 Seoul (KR), 2026 Austin (US). Host for 2027 not announced.
pattern.review_process: Double-blind on OpenReview (robot-learning.org/CoRL/YYYY/Conference) with Area Chairs (plus Senior Area Chairs from 2026), aiming for at least two reviews per paper; reviews are released to authors followed by a one-page anonymous PDF rebuttal (no per-reviewer replies or paper updates in 2025-2026), then a reviewer-AC discussion week before decisions. Since 2026, papers with no score of weak accept or better are rejected without rebuttal. Reviews and rebuttals of accepted papers are made public; proceedings appear in PMLR.

resubmission_rules.dual_submission: Not allowed by default: submissions simultaneously under review at another archival venue are desk-rejected. Case-by-case exceptions when another venue's decision date slightly overlaps the CoRL review period (e.g. ICML decisions on May 1), only if the Publication Chair is notified before submission with the overlapping venue and dates.
resubmission_rules.arxiv: Permitted: 'Submission is permitted for papers that have previously appeared only as a technical report, e.g., in arXiv.' Papers previously published or accepted at an archival venue, or identical/substantially similar to such papers, are not accepted.
resubmission_rules.page_limit: 8 pages main text (acknowledgments, references, appendix and - since 2025 - the Limitations section excluded); camera-ready may use 9 pages from 2026.
resubmission_rules.author_list: Authors cannot be added or removed after the abstract deadline (2025-2026).
resubmission_rules.reciprocal_reviewing: Every author with 3 or more submissions must agree to serve as a reviewer (2025-2026).
resubmission_rules.planning_hint: CoRL decisions (early Sep) land after the ICRA deadline (mid-Sep) is nearly closed and before ICLR/RSS deadlines; a CoRL reject in early September can typically be turned around for ICLR (late Sep/early Oct) or RSS (late Jan/early Feb) - verify those venues' own dates.

editions.name: CoRL 2027
notes: NOT ANNOUNCED as of 2026-09-21: no host city, dates or deadlines for CoRL 2027 appear on corl.org, robot-learning.org (Robot Learning Foundation), @corl_conf, OpenReview, or the deadline aggregators (submitforge lists it as 'To Be Announced'). CoRL usually reveals the next host at or shortly after the current conference (Nov 2026), and the CFP with key dates around late January.

All dates above are ESTIMATES from the 2023-2026 pattern: paper deadline on a Thursday in late May / early June (Jun 8 2023, Jun 6 2024, May 28 2026; the 2025 Apr 30 outlier was due to the September conference), abstract registration ~3 days earlier (introduced 2025), reviews released ~early Aug with a 7-day rebuttal, notification in the first days of September (Aug 30 2023, Sep 4 2024, Sep 4 2026), camera-ready mid-October, conference Mon-Thu in early/mid November.

Location estimate only: CoRL alternates US <-> non-US (2023 Atlanta, 2024 Munich, 2025 Seoul, 2026 Austin), so 2027 is more likely outside the US (Europe or Asia-Pacific), but nothing is announced; continent left null.
If the 2027 conference is again moved earlier (as in 2025, co-located with Humanoids), expect the deadline to shift to late April; re-check corl.org in Nov 2026 - Feb 2027.
